/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::r1_wire::row_shape]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/r1_wire.rs', lines 39:0-49:1
    Visibility: public -/
def r1_wire.row_shape
  (row : Std.U8) : Result (Option (Std.U8 × Std.Usize)) := do
  match row with
  | 0#uscalar => ok (some (0#u8, 0#usize))
  | 1#uscalar => ok (some (0#u8, 0#usize))
  | 2#uscalar => ok (some (1#u8, 32#usize))
  | 14#uscalar => ok (some (3#u8, 32#usize))
  | 25#uscalar =>
    let i ← r1_wire.CLAIMS
    let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i r1_wire.LANES)
    let i2 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul i1 32#usize)
    ok (some (4#u8, i2))
  | 26#uscalar =>
    let i ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul r1_wire.LANES 32#usize)
    ok (some (5#u8, i))
  | _ =>
    if 3#u8 <= row
    then
      if row <= 13#u8
      then ok (some (0#u8, 0#usize))
      else
        if 15#u8 <= row
        then
          if row <= 24#u8
          then
            let i ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 28#usize 32#usize)
            ok (some (2#u8, i))
          else ok none
        else ok none
    else
      if 15#u8 <= row
      then
        if row <= 24#u8
        then
          let i ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 28#usize 32#usize)
          ok (some (2#u8, i))
        else ok none
      else ok none

def r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.sample_block_validated
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (self : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H) (row : Std.U8) (framed : Slice Std.U8)
  :
  Result ((core.result.Result (Array Std.U8 32#usize) r1_wire.Error) ×
    (r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H))
  := do
  if row != self.next_row
  then
    ok (core.result.Result.Err (r1_wire.Error.RowOrder self.next_row row),
      self)
  else
    let s ← lift (Array.to_slice self.state)
    let i ← lift (Std.U8.wrapping_add 160#u8 row)
    let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ 0#u8, i ]))
    let s2 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 3#usize [ s, s1, framed ]))
    let absorbed ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self.hash s2
    let s3 ← lift (Array.to_slice absorbed)
    let s4 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 1#u8 ]))
    let s5 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s3, s4 ]))
    let block ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self.hash s5
    let s6 ← lift (Array.to_slice absorbed)
    let s7 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 2#u8 ]))
    let s8 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s6, s7 ]))
    let a ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self.hash s8
    let i1 ← lift (Std.U8.wrapping_add self.next_row 1#u8)
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok block, { self with state := a, next_row := i1 })

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::r1_wire::semantic20::checked]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/r1_wire.rs', lines 881:4-892:5
    Visibility: public -/
def r1_wire.semantic20.checked
  (row : Std.U8) (record1 : Slice Std.U8) :
  Result (core.result.Result Unit r1_wire.Error)
  := do
  let o ← r1_wire.row_shape row
  match o with
  | none => ok (core.result.Result.Err r1_wire.Error.InvalidRow)
  | some shape =>
    let (tag, size) := shape
    let i := Slice.len record1
    let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add 5#usize size)
    if i != i1
    then ok (core.result.Result.Err (r1_wire.Error.Length row))
    else
      let i2 ← Slice.index_usize record1 0#usize
      if i2 != tag
      then ok (core.result.Result.Err (r1_wire.Error.Tag row))
      else
        let i3 ← Slice.index_usize record1 1#usize
        let i4 ← Slice.index_usize record1 2#usize
        let i5 ← Slice.index_usize record1 3#usize
        let i6 ← Slice.index_usize record1 4#usize
        let i7 ←
          lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes
            (Array.make 4#usize [ i3, i4, i5, i6 ]))
        let i8 ← lift (UScalar.cast .Usize i7)
        if i8 != size
        then ok (core.result.Result.Err (r1_wire.Error.Length row))
        else
          if row >= 14#u8
          then
            let s ←
              core.slice.index.Slice.index
                (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice Std.U8) record1
                { start := 5#usize }
            let v ← alloc.slice.Slice.to_vec core.clone.CloneU8 s
            let r ← r1_wire.fields20.validate row v 0#usize
            match r with
            | core.result.Result.Ok _ => ok (core.result.Result.Ok ())
            | core.result.Result.Err _ => ok r
          else ok (core.result.Result.Ok ())

def r1_wire.circle25.point
  {H : Type} {P : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst :
  aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (PolicyInst : r1_wire.circle25.Policy P)
  (state : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H) (row : Std.U8)
  (record1 : alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) :
  Result ((core.result.Result (Array aspis_core.field.QM31 2#usize)
    r1_wire.Error) × (r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H))
  := do
  match row with
  | 25#uscalar =>
    if 25#u8 != state.next_row
    then
      ok (core.result.Result.Err (r1_wire.Error.RowOrder state.next_row 25#u8),
        state)
    else
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref record1
      let r ← r1_wire.semantic20.checked 25#u8 s
      match r with
      | core.result.Result.Ok _ =>
        let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref record1
        let (r1, state1) ←
          r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.sample_block_validated
            aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst state 25#u8 s1
        match r1 with
        | core.result.Result.Ok b =>
          let a ← PolicyInst.point b false
          ok (core.result.Result.Ok a, state1)
        | core.result.Result.Err e => ok (core.result.Result.Err e, state1)
      | core.result.Result.Err e => ok (core.result.Result.Err e, state)
  | 26#uscalar =>
    if 26#u8 != state.next_row
    then
      ok (core.result.Result.Err (r1_wire.Error.RowOrder state.next_row 26#u8),
        state)
    else
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref record1
      let r ← r1_wire.semantic20.checked 26#u8 s
      match r with
      | core.result.Result.Ok _ =>
        let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref record1
        let (r1, state1) ←
          r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.sample_block_validated
            aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst state 26#u8 s1
        match r1 with
        | core.result.Result.Ok b =>
          let a ← PolicyInst.point b true
          ok (core.result.Result.Ok a, state1)
        | core.result.Result.Err e => ok (core.result.Result.Err e, state1)
      | core.result.Result.Err e => ok (core.result.Result.Err e, state)
  | _ => ok (core.result.Result.Err r1_wire.Error.InvalidRow, state)
